description: P&O algorithm tracking model with static/dynamic efficiency, convergence oscillation, and converter losses

unit.name: 10 kW MPPT Controller with P&O Algorithm
unit.source: Hohm & Ropp (2003), Prog. Photovoltaics, 11, 47-62; Femia et al. (2005), IEEE Trans. Power Electron.

P_max.note: Maximum PV array power at STC

eta_static.note: Static tracking efficiency at steady MPP

V_mpp_ref.note: MPP voltage at STC for reference array

dPdV_mpp.note: Slope dP/dV at MPP (negative, steepness of P-V peak)

tau_track.note: Tracking time constant for dynamic response
